entry.title: dotnet/maui - Releases - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
.NET MAUI 11.0.10

.NET MAUI 11.0.10 Release Notes

.NET MAUI 11.0.10 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 370 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

Ai Agents

  • Add probability-scored duplicate issue detection by @kubaflo in #39218

Animation

  • Fix AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #37639

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive

  • Fix AnimationExtensions.Insert — disposed non-starting manager leaves callback statically rooted by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #37572

🔧 Fixes
  • [leak-scan] AnimationExtensions.Insert — disposed non-starting manager leaves callback statically rooted

API

  • [api] Mark .NET 11 GA APIs as shipped on main by @kubaflo in #39807

Architecture

  • Support consistent XAML type references by @StephaneDelcroix in #39890

    🔧 Fixes
    • Should we adopt consistent syntax for TypeArguments and Type too?

Blazor

  • [Windows] Enable external file drops in BlazorWebView by @danroth27 in #37904

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] BlazorWebView should enable WebView2.AllowDrop for external file drops

  • [BlazorWebView] Fix dispatcher exception propagation by @jfversluis in #37974

  • [Android] Configure image drag support for BlazorWebView by @danroth27 in #37975

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Configure DropDataContentProvider for BlazorWebView image dragging

  • Fix problem with null VirtualView in BlazorWebViewHandler on iOS by @JimmyPun610 in #38141

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS BlazorWebView crash the app sometime

  • Fix for handler leaks by traversing non-IView Shell nodes in DisconnectHandlers() by @BagavathiPerumal in #38022

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS: DisconnectHandlers() never reaches pages inside a Shell — BlazorWebView/WebViewManager leak permanently when Window.Page is replaced

  • [Android]Fix for Android BlazorWebView crash when opening image links in a new window by @BagavathiPerumal in #38195

    🔧 Fixes
    • <a target="_blank"> with image child <img src="data:image"/> causes app crash on Android in MAUI Blazor Hybrid

  • [inflight/current] Fix BlazorWebView root component subscriptions on disconnect (#39247) by @kubaflo in #39252

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] BlazorWebViewHandler never unsubscribes from RootComponents.CollectionChanged on disconnect, retaining the old MauiContext and finished Activity

  • Fix iOS BlazorWebView callbacks after disconnection by @sheiksyedm in #39430

    🔧 Fixes
    • BlazorWebViewHandler.iOS.cs NullReferenceException when web view has been disconnected

  • [WPF] Fix BlazorWebView disposal hanging when cleanup awaits JS interop by @sheiksyedm in #39497

    🔧 Fixes
    • [WPF] BlazorWebView.DisposeAsync never completes when a scoped service or component awaits JS interop on disposal

BlazorWebView

  • Fix inflight/current BlazorWebView and UI-test build failures by @kubaflo in #38574

Border

  • ContentView and Border: hidden content shouldn't take up space by @FullDevStudio in #39560

Button

  • [Android] Fix ImageButton not rendering when CornerRadius is larger than half its size by @KirkPatrickJunsay in #39344

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] ImageButton does not render its background when CornerRadius is larger than half of its size (regression in .NET 10)

  • [iOS/Mac] Fix Button with gradient Background ignores CornerRadius by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #39484

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Button with gradient Background ignores CornerRadius (regression in 10.0.80)

  • [Android]Fix for Android ImageButton Border Visibility and Update Test Snapshots for Issue by @BagavathiPerumal in #39526

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] ImageButton Border Not Rendering Correctly with URI and File Images when applying Aspect property

CollectionView

  • [Windows] CarouselView: Fix mouse-wheel snapping by @jfversluis in #37387

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] CarouselView infinite auto-scrolling issue

  • Fix grouped CollectionView EmptyView on iOS by @jfversluis in #37959

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView (grouped): EmptyView handling is wrong when groups become empty

  • [Android] CollectionView: Fix grouped EmptyView updates by @jfversluis in #37954

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView (grouped): EmptyView handling is wrong when groups become empty

  • [iOS] Horizontal CollectionView jumps to beginning by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #37307

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS Horizontal CollectionView jumps to beginning

  • [iOS] CollectionView2: Fix layout for dynamically rebuilt item content by @jfversluis in #37437

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView item content renders with zero width on iOS (CollectionViewHandler2)

  • [iOS] Fix CollectionView Label Truncation with MeasureFirstItem by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #38338

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CollectionView Label renders truncated after ItemsSource is swapped with ItemSizingStrategy="MeasureFirstItem" (regression in 10.0.100)

  • [Android] Prevent CollectionView EmptyView crash after handler disconnect by @Shalini-Ashokan in #38653

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView EmptyView callback throws PlatformView cannot be null after handler disconnect

  • [Inflight/Candidate] [iOS] Fix for CollectionView layout issue after iOS device rotation by @kubaflo in #38815

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I1_RTL_FlowDirection - Rotating the iOS simulator causes the item layout to change

  • [inflight/candidate] [iOS] Fix CarouselView template selector crash during cell reconfiguration by @kubaflo in #39254

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CarouselView throws NSInternalInconsistencyException with data templates and template selector

  • [inflight/candidate] [iOS] Fix CollectionView items disappearing after orientation change by @kubaflo in #39322

    🔧 Fixes
    • [inflight-Regression] [iOS] CollectionView Items Disappearing After Device Orientation Change

  • [inflight/candidate] [Android] Backport grid spacing regression fix for #38925 by @kubaflo in #39335

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView with GridItemsLayout: SpacingItemDecoration walks all positions for every cell — ItemsSource assignment and scrolling take seconds to minutes, ANR on fling (regression in 10.0.100)

  • [inflight/candidate] Fix iOS CollectionView selection during Shell navigation by @github-actions[bot] in #39327

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView items not rendered properly on iOS when SelectedItem assigned in ApplyQueryAttributes

  • [inflight/candidate] Fix Windows CollectionView selection crash by @github-actions[bot] in #39329

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] L2 _TabBar Switching Test - Crashes when opening L2

  • [Inflight/Candidate] Stabilize Looped CarouselView Collection Override Device Test by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #39217

  • [inflight/candidate] [Mac] Fix blank content in RefreshView with CollectionView during scrolling by @kubaflo in #39357

    🔧 Fixes
    • C2 & C5: Content turns blank when dragging a slider or scrolling the mouse wheel on the Mac Catalyst platform.

  • [inflight/candidate] [Android] Fix CollectionView selection with pointer gestures (#37952) by @kubaflo in #39387

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView item selection not triggered when using PointerGestureRecognizer

  • [Inflight/Candidate][iOS] Fix for unnecessary arrange passes in CollectionView2 by @BagavathiPerumal in #39396

    🔧 Fixes
    • [inflight regression] LayoutPassesShouldNotIncrease UI test failing in candidate PR 38782

  • [Windows] Fix CollectionView CV2 retention after dynamic removal by @sheiksyedm in #39543

  • [Windows] CollectionView: keep the header in the logical tree on update by @FullDevStudio in #39590

  • [Windows][CV2][Net11] Fix CollectionView exception thrown when ItemsSource is set to Null by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39554

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Net11][Windows]CollectionView exception thrown when ItemsSource is set to Null

  • [Windows] Fix CollectionView Scrolling with Animate Scroll Disabled by @Vignesh-SF3580 in #39500

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I9_Scrolling - Turn off the "Animated Scrolling" and then trigger the scroll action twice, after which clicking the scroll button will no longer work

  • [net11][Test failure] [Windows]Fix CollectionView2 selection crash during handler disconnection by @BagavathiPerumal in #39706

  • [Inflight/Current] [iOS]Fix for CollectionView layout issue after iOS device rotation by @BagavathiPerumal in #38771

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I1_RTL_FlowDirection - Rotating the iOS simulator causes the item layout to change

  • [Windows] Fix doubled CollectionView item spacing by @jfversluis in #38960

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView.ItemsLayout LinearItemsLayout ItemSpacing behaves significantly differently on Windows compared to Android (possibly Mac/iOS too)

  • [Android] Fix O(n²) layout cost in CollectionView GridItemsLayout (SpacingItemDecoration + ObservableGroupedSource) by @unrateddi in #38969

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView with GridItemsLayout: SpacingItemDecoration walks all positions for every cell — ItemsSource assignment and scrolling take seconds to minutes, ANR on fling (regression in 10.0.100)
    • [Android] CollectionView GridItemsLayout: span lookups over uncached positions are O(position) per cell, O(position²) when grouped — ScrollTo last group takes ~38 s for 10 000 items, scrolling up after a jump stutters

  • [inflight/current] [Mac] Fix VoiceOver announcement for actionable CollectionView items by @kubaflo in #39012

    🔧 Fixes
    • VoiceOver does not announce the role or interactivity of task items, making them appear as static text: A11y_.NET MAUI SDKs_VoiceOver

  • [Android] CollectionView GridItemsLayout: resolve span index and row from the items source instead of walking every position by @unrateddi in #39063

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView GridItemsLayout: span lookups over uncached positions are O(position) per cell, O(position²) when grouped — ScrollTo last group takes ~38 s for 10 000 items, scrolling up after a jump stutters

  • [Android] Keep CarouselView Position when CurrentItem isn't in the ItemsSource by @MykhailoDav in #39151

    🔧 Fixes
    • Android - Carousel View - always get an error "Can't set CarouselView to position -1. ItemsSource has 10 items."

  • [Android] Prevent unnecessary CollectionView item recreation on Header/Footer updates by @SuthiYuvaraj in #38808

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Changing CollectionView.Header recreates the adapter and every visible item view (regression in 10.0.101)

  • [Android] Keep EmptyViewAdapter view types from matching the items adapter's by @MykhailoDav in #39193

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView with an EmptyView or EmptyViewTemplate gets potentially corrupted after being cleared and repopulated a number of times

  • [iOS] Fix vertical CarouselView Position synchronization by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #39377

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Vertical CarouselView scrolls and snaps but fails to update Position or raise PositionChanged (Loop=False)

  • [Windows] Fix excessive blank space between CollectionView grid items by @Shalini-Ashokan in #39429

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I6_Grouping_VerticalItemSpacing :Grouped CollectionView have extra space

  • [iOS/MacCatalyst] Fixed CollectionView: Preserve visible position when item spacing changes by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #37032

🔧 Fixes
  • I2-After changing the vertical spacing, need to scroll up to make the first item visible.

  • [iOS/Mac] Fix CollectionView2 height not updating when ItemsSource changes by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38441

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Mac][iOS] CollectionView does not shrink its rendered height after ItemsSource is updated with fewer items

  • [Windows] Fix EmptyViewTemplate not displayed when ItemsSource is set to Null by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39513

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] EmptyViewTemplate not displayed when ItemsSource is set to Null

  • [Windows] Avoid CollectionView GroupHeaderStyleSelector accumulation by @sheiksyedm in #39525

  • [iOS] Collapse CollectionView group headers when their content is hidden by @carloshenriquecarniatto in #39533

  • [iOS] Fix Label truncation after item text updates in CollectionView by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39558

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CollectionView Label renders truncated after Text updated with ItemSizingStrategy="MeasureFirstItem" (regression in 10.0.100, 10.0.110 & 10.0.120)

  • [Windows] Fix Compatibility CollectionView compilation on inflight/candidate by @sheiksyedm in #39662

  • [iOS, Catalyst] Fix IndicatorView not visible when applying RTL FlowDirection with IndicatorTemplate by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39501

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, Catalyst] IndicatorView not visible when applying FlowDirection=RightToLeft with IndicatorTemplate

  • [inflight/Candidate]Fix CollectionViewItemSafeAreaEdgesShouldBePreservedWithShadow UI test failure by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39698

    🔧 Fixes
    • [inflight regression] CollectionViewItemSafeAreaEdgesShouldBePreservedWithShadow UI test failing in candidate PR 39597

  • [Inflight/Candidate][Revert] [iOS] Fix for CollectionView layout issue after iOS device rotation #38771 by @TamilarasanSF4853 in #39707

  • [NET 11][Windows] Fix CollectionView crashes when multiple CollectionViews share the same ObservableCollection by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39760

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows][.NET 11] CollectionView crashes when multiple CollectionViews share the same ObservableCollection

  • [iOS/Mac][Revert] CollectionView2 height-update fix (#38441) by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #39856

    🔧 Fixes
    • [NET 10] N_ScrollView - There are 2 vertical scrollbars on N1 and N4 for iOS

  • [main] [iOS/MacCatalyst] Fix RTL CollectionView item positioning after rotation by @github-actions[bot] in #39894

Core Lifecycle

  • [Windows] Mark MauiWinUIApplication properties obsolete by @jfversluis in #37957

  • [inflight/candidate] Revert deferred Android Loaded event (#38769) by @kubaflo in #38784

    🔧 Fixes
    • Android: Behavior Change in the Loaded Event Observed in Version 10.0.60+

DateTimePicker

  • [iOS] Fix TimePicker forcing en-US culture on iOS instead of device culture by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #37797

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] TimePicker forces en-US (12-hour AM/PM) when Format is left at its default "t", ignoring the device culture
    • [iOS] TimePicker AM/PM frequently changes when the app is closed and reopened

Docs

  • Use country/region consistently in Locale documentation by @jfversluis in #39980

  • [docs] Explain workload set and Visual Studio insertion handoff by @rmarinho in #39977

Drawing

  • [Windows] Fix GraphicsView crash during repeated drawing by @jfversluis in #37419

    🔧 Fixes
    • Bug Report: App crashes when drawing text on pointer pressed in GraphicsView (Windows)

  • [Windows] Fix Border clipping for transformed content by @jfversluis in #37424

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] Border clipping incorrect when Content is scaled (or has any other Transform applied?)

  • Use SkiaSharp arc drawing API by @jfversluis in #37955

  • Remove obsolete Graphics projects by @rmarinho in #39530

    🔧 Fixes
    • [net9.0] Refining Microsoft.Maui.Graphics in .NET 9.0 Branch

  • [iOS, Mac] Fix GraphicsView drawable shadows ignoring FlowDirection by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #39544

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, macOS] GraphicsView Shadow does not respect FlowDirection changes

  • Fix TransformGroup memory leak with shared TransformCollection by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38738

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] TransformGroup.Children — shared collection strongly retains transform group

  • Fix GeometryHelper flatteners generating NaN points when segment count truncates to 0 by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #38814

    🔧 Fixes
    • GeometryHelper.FlattenArc / FlattenCubicBezier / FlattenQuadraticBezier emit a NaN point when the segment count truncates to 0 (0/0) — a Path with a sub-pixel arc fail-fasts Windows with D2DERR_BAD_NUMBER (root cause of #8512, #13757)
    • PathIcon use Lucide svg path throw an exception

  • Fix PathFigure memory leak with shared PathSegmentCollection by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #38744

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] PathFigure.Segments — shared collection strongly retains path figure

  • [Android] Fix Shape clipping after display density changes by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #39249

    🔧 Fixes
    • MAUI Shapes render incorrectly after Android display density change

  • [iOS] Fix SafeAreaEdges on a CollectionView/CarouselView item template root is ignored when the root has a Shadow by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #39255

🔧 Fixes
  • [iOS] SafeAreaEdges on a CollectionView/CarouselView item template root is ignored when the root has a Shadow

  • Fix Rectangle Rendering as a Thin Line for Small Heights by @Dhivya-SF4094 in #37319

    🔧 Fixes
    • Rectangle renders as thin line instead of filled shape for small height values

Editor

  • [Windows] TextBox: Cache template ScrollViewer by @jfversluis in #38027

  • [Android] Fix Material 3 Editor expanding to MaximumHeightRequest by @Shalini-Ashokan in #38587

    🔧 Fixes
    • [android] Editor auto expands wrongly to MaximumHeightRequest

  • [inflight/candidate] [iOS] Editor can't be scrolled after rotating simulator. by @github-actions[bot] in #39318

    🔧 Fixes
    • [.NET 10][iOS] D2 - Editor can't be scrolled after rotating simulator.

Entry

  • [Windows] ScrollView: Prevent automatic Entry focus by @jfversluis in #37428

    🔧 Fixes
    • MAUI Entry Gains Focus Automatically When Placed Inside ScrollView on Windows

  • [Testing] Refactoring Feature Matrix UITest Cases for Entry Control by @LogishaSelvarajSF4525 in #37111

  • [Android] Fix numeric Entry decimal-point input in comma-decimal cultures by @sheiksyedm in #39286

    🔧 Fixes
    • Entry Numeric Keyboard Does Not Properly Support Decimal Commas

Essentials

  • [Android] Use typed API 33 Parcelable overload by @jfversluis in #37956

  • [Android] Geolocation: Select providers explicitly on API 34 by @jfversluis in #37976

  • [Android] MediaPicker: Stop overwriting picked source files by @mattleibow in #38029

  • [iOS] Migrate deprecated Browser, FilePicker, and font APIs by @jfversluis in #38025

  • [Android] Validate physical paths returned by pickers by @mattleibow in #38127

    🔧 Fixes

    🔧 Fixes

Essentials Devicedisplay

  • Update iOS orientation handling to use UIDevice.CurrentDevice by @jgold6 in #39398

    🔧 Fixes

Frame

  • [ci] Use matching Xcode for previous-framework Apple integration tests by @kubaflo in #39832

General

  • Fix GradientBrush memory leak with shared GradientStops by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #37893

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] GradientBrush.GradientStops — shared collection strongly retains the brush

  • Fix ARGB value for MediumPurple color by @TomasGnG in #39077

    🔧 Fixes
    • [bug: Graphics] Colors.MediumPurple has incorrect ARGB value (#FF9370D8 instead of #FF9370DB)

Gestures

  • [Controls] Remove unused DropResult property by @jfversluis in #37401

    🔧 Fixes

    • [iOS/MacCatalyst] TapGestureRecognizer.NumberOfTapsRequired is not reactive at runtime

    🔧 Fixes

Grid

Hybridwebview

  • [Testing] Refactoring Feature Matrix UITest Cases for HybridWebView Control by @HarishKumarSF4517 in #39179

  • [NET11] [Android][Test Failure] Fix HybridWebView remains attached to its parent after handler disconnect by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #39695

  • [iOS]Fix for HybridWebView JavaScript Evaluation Exceptions and Incomplete Requests by @BagavathiPerumal in #39469

    • [iOS] HybridWebView: failed EvaluateJavaScriptAsync crashes the app instead of faulting the Task

Image

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Image.HeightRequest not respected when Image added in an Horizontal StackLayout

  • Fix app crash when loading large URI images by @jonathanpeppers in #38204

  • [Android] Fix blurry Material 3 images when scaled by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #38362

    • [Android][Material 3] PDF Pages Render Blurry During Zooming After Upgrading from .NET MAUI 10.0.51 to 10.0.60+

  • [Graphics] PlatformImage: Read PNG dimensions from IHDR by @Nacl-HCl in #39378

    🔧 Fixes

Label

  • [Android/iOS] Fix Label background not clearing when set to null by @Shalini-Ashokan in #37182

    🔧 Fixes
    • Label Background rest to null, it does not go to default.

  • Fix SetDynamicResource does not update the Background property of the Label by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #38063

    • SetDynamicResource does not update the Background property of the Label

  • [release] Derive prerelease labels and SR stabilization from source branches by @kubaflo in #40042

Layout

  • Fix effective visibility propagation by @jfversluis in #37546

  • Fix irregular placement of views with margins by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #37080

    🔧 Fixes
    • Irregular placement of views with margins

  • [inflight/candidate] [iOS 27] Fix TitleView sizing before navigation bar layout (#39285) by @kubaflo in #39389

  • [iOS] Use window scene display for layout decisions by @jfversluis in #38911

  • Handlers: Add opt-in initialization attribution by @StephaneDelcroix in #37836
